description: OMENZ Package Check: is this software package safe for your agent to install? npm, PyPI, Go, Cargo, Maven, NuGet. BLOCK if the package does not exist (hallucinated name: slopsquatting risk, with 'did you mean') or the version has HIGH/CRITICAL known vulnerabilities; CAUTION if deprecated, under 30 days old, any known vuln, no license, or a near-miss of a popular package name (typosquat); SAFE_TO_INSTALL otherwise. Returns the vulns, the version to upgrade to, license and package age. Sources: deps.dev + OSV.dev. Deterministic, read-only. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/package/check, $0.003 via x402.)
name: package_check
title: OMENZ Package Check
